name: Confines (Colombia)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, white and green, the white charged with a blue triangle bearing a monument and the inscription MONUMENTO NACIONAL CONFINES.
history: Municipal flag of Confines, a municipality in the department of Santander, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: triangle at the centre with a monument and inscription
